source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

This rendering genuinely excited me. We are incredibly close now! [FREELANCER_NAME_001], this is truly beautiful work.

Having spent some time considering the options, I believe Option B is the strongest route. It provides the confidence, restraint, and architectural character I wanted.

Option A strikes me as slightly too sharp. I appreciate the softness in Option C, but Option B best expresses the overall personality.

For the next presentation, please keep everything else exactly unchanged and test only these very small adjustments:

1. Use Option B as the starting point and extend the Hero V’s right arm ever so slightly, adding only a little more reach while preserving precisely the same slope and geometry. Repeat that exact refinement on the second V and the É accent. The difference should be extremely subtle. A horizontal reference line may help me see exactly how far the right arm rises above the left arm. I believe this relationship may ultimately become a defining shared feature of the Hero V, second V, and É accent.

2. From that same Option B version, retain the identical reach but soften the terminal by the smallest amount. I do not want added curvature; I only want a gentler ending that maintains the existing architectural quality. The corners might become marginally softer, while the tip itself should stay straight rather than curve.

3. Begin with Option C and introduce the same slight increase in reach, again leaving the slope and overall geometry intact and applying it consistently to the Hero V, second V, and É accent.

We are now dealing with extremely small adjustments. The broad architecture should stay locked while we examine only these last nuances.

Thank you again—I’m extremely excited to see the outcome!
